params.scriptBody:

set -e
for i in ${bamboo.METADATA_VERSION}; do
ssh   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${bamboo.OBP_NODE_1} "sudo -u oracle -- sh -c 'set -e ; source /home/oracle/.bash_profile ; cd ${bamboo.OBP_DEPLOY_HOME};rm -rf ../../../cache;  ${bamboo.GRADLE_HOME}/bin/gradle -b deployMetadata.gradle -g ../../../cache -PuseDeployConfig=true -PconfigProviderPath=${bamboo.CONFIGPROVIDERPATH} -PfetchTargets=true -PenvName=LOCAL -PmetadataVersion=${bamboo.METADATA_VERSION} -PbankCode=${bamboo.BANK_CODE} -PbankTransactionCode=${bamboo.BANK_TRANSACTION_CODE} -PbankTargetUnit=${bamboo.BANK_TARGET_UNIT} -PfcServer=${bamboo.FCSERVER} -PsoaServer=${bamboo.SOASERVERWITHPORT} -PartifactoryUrl=${bamboo.productArtifactoryURL} -PreleasePath=${bamboo.CEMLI_RELEASE_PATH} --refresh-dependencies deploy clean'"
done;

set -e
echo "Downloading the soa extensions version ${prodVersion} from artifactory"
	ssh   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${bamboo.OBP_NODE_1} "sudo -u oracle -- sh -c 'set -e ; source /home/oracle/.bash_profile ; cd ${bamboo.OBP_DEPLOY_HOME1}; rm -rf ../../../cache; ${bamboo.GRADLE_HOME}/bin/gradle -b soaExtenComp.gradle -g ../../../cache -PuseDeployConfig=true -PconfigProviderPath=${bamboo.CONFIGPROVIDERPATH1} -PfetchTargets=true -PenvName=LOCAL --refresh-dependencies -PsoaExtensionsVersion=${bamboo.SOA_COMPOSITE_VERSION} -PartifactoryURL=${bamboo.cemliArtifactoryURL} -PreleasePath=${bamboo.CEMLI_RELEASE_PATH} deploy clean -s'"

set -e
	echo "Execting the soa incremental Script"
	ssh   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${bamboo.OBP_NODE_1} "sudo -u oracle -- sh -c 'set -e ; source /home/oracle/.bash_profile ; cd ${bamboo.OBP_DEPLOY_HOME1}; chmod 755 scripts/*; ${bamboo.GRADLE_HOME}/bin/gradle -b soaIncrScript.gradle -g ../../../cache -PuseDeployConfig=true -PconfigProviderPath=${bamboo.CONFIGPROVIDERPATH1} -PfetchTargets=true -PenvName=LOCAL --refresh-dependencies -PmintDeployHome=../../../mintdeploy deploy clean -s'"

set -e
ssh   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${bamboo.OBP_NODE_1} "sudo -u oracle -- sh -c 'set -e ; source /home/oracle/.bash_profile ; cd ${bamboo.OBP_STARTSCRIPT_HOME}; ${bamboo.GRADLE_HOME}/bin/gradle -PmintDeployHome=../../../mintdeploy -PfetchTargets=true -PenvName=LOCAL -PconfigProviderPath=${bamboo.CONFIGPROVIDERPATH} -PscriptToRun=start-obpbam.py deploy clean -s'"

set -e
ssh   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${bamboo.OBP_NODE_1} "sudo -u oracle -- sh -c 'set -e ; source /home/oracle/.bash_profile ; cd ${bamboo.OBP_DEPLOY_HOME}; chmod 755 scripts/*; rm -rf ../../bam_cache; ${bamboo.GRADLE_HOME}/bin/gradle -b obpBAMDownload.gradle -g ../../bam_cache -PbamVersion=${bamboo.CEMLI_BAM_VERSION} -PuseDeployConfig=true -PartifactoryURL=${bamboo.cemliArtifactoryURL} -PreleasePath=${bamboo.CEMLI_RELEASE_PATH}  deploy clean -s'"

url=${bamboo.cemliArtifactoryURL}/`echo ${bamboo.CEMLI_RELEASE_PATH}|sed -r "s|\.|/|g"`/extensionsobpscripts/${bamboo.OBPSCRIPTSVERSION}/extensionsobpscripts-${bamboo.OBPSCRIPTSVERSION}.zip
if curl -k --output /dev/null --silent --head --fail "$url"; then
  echo "Artefact exists: $url"
else
  echo "Artefact does not exist: $url"
  exit 1
fi
set -e
